description: This file defines Express.js routes for project-related API endpoints, including project name resolution and cost/usage calculations, utilizing various services and utilities.

methods.name: round6
methods.description: Rounds a number to 6 decimal places to match normalization used in routes/costs.js

methods.name: computeProjectCostUSD
methods.description: Asynchronously computes total USD cost for a given projectId using analytics.getCosts

methods.name: buildUsagePayload
methods.description: Builds a payload with projectId, costUSD, creditsUsed, and currency, with both camelCase and snake_case fields
